Treatment summary
Patient presented following a side-impact collision at an intersection, reporting neck
and back pain. Over four visits, the patient was evaluated and treated for cervical and
lumbar strain. Imaging and examination findings clearly confirm the soft-tissue
injury, with objective muscle guarding and reduced range of motion in both regions. No
earlier injury to the same body areas is known from the history obtained. Causation
from this specific collision is not yet clear and will be reassessed as further records
become available. Treatment duration ran somewhat longer than is typical for this
presentation, and the course was tailored to the patient's response at each visit.
Billing records were reviewed and show no repeated charges for the same services.
Conservative management is ongoing, with follow-up planned to monitor symptoms,
functional progress, and return-to-activity goals.

injury. Do not list the date of a note, letter, report, visit, statement, filing or signature.

it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
